intro.fr: Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist: Link Evolution se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist: Link Evolution can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Other Ocean Interactive sort Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist: Link Evolution en 2019.
text.en: Other Ocean Interactive releases Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist: Link Evolution in 2019.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub HillbillyDroid/YGO-LotD-LE-APWorld, qui héberge l'APWorld de Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist: Link Evolution.
text.en: The GitHub repository HillbillyDroid/YGO-LotD-LE-APWorld, home of the Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist: Link Evolution APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v0.0.1.
text.en: The first version, v0.0.1, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v0.0.2, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (2 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v0.0.2 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (2 versions released).

text.fr: Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist: Link Evolution figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist: Link Evolution is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
